options_te: Current scored answerగా కాక held/unscoredగా ఉంచి, concept questionగా మాత్రమే వాడాలి లేదా FAOSTATతో verify చేయాలి

Export rankను production rankగా మార్చాలి
Country orderను guess చేయాలి
options_en: Keep it held or unscored rather than treating it as current; use it only as a concept question or verify it with FAOSTAT
Score the old answer permanently
Convert the export rank into a production rank
Guess the country order

The indicators are not interchangeable.
